INT. KITCHEN - DAY

Steam rises from a pot. It bubbles
and spits.

                    ANNA (CONT'D)
               (quietly)
          It's ready, she says, and
          it really is.

                    BEN
               (continuing)
          What?

                    ANNA
               (smiling and
                hopping along)
          Nothing.

                                        CUT TO:

EXT. GARDEN - NIGHT

Quiet.
                                                            12.
